newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian bankruptcies higher in March quarter.
newsitem.headline: Australian bankruptcies higher in March quarter.

text.p: Australian bankruptcies rose to 5,351 in the March quarter, up 21 percent on the same quarter a year earlier, according to figures issued by Attorney-General Daryl Williams on Monday.
Bankruptcies for the latest four quarters -- 15,910 -- were 27 percent higher the previous four quarters.
Among the six states, the biggest rise in bankruptcies occured in Queensland, where the number rose 37 percent between the March quarters of 1996 and 1997 to 1,443.
